blocks.text: MOSCOW — Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, has died suddenly at age 66 after one and a half years in the job, Moscow’s foreign ministry announced Wednesday. The ministry called Darchiev an “outstanding diplomat, an experienced leader and a kind colleague”. He was appointed in March 2025. Moscow did not give more details on the death. READ: US envoys to meet Putin, Zelensky after war talks in Abu Dhabi The US State Department said Darchiev died Wednesday in Moscow. “We offer our condolences to Ambassador Darchiev’s family and loved ones.
